tonight.headline: Down 31.5 before a snap: McLaurin practised, Monangai is in a boot, Likely is cleared
body: Bad news first. Kyle Monangai is out, in a walking boot, and his coach says the toe is 'a bigger deal than we initially anticipated'. Justin Jefferson and Jordan Addison are both questionable and Minnesota decide on Saturday. You are 0–4 and 31.5 behind on Bucky Irving's Thursday night; ESPN has you at 45%, 122.1 against 130.8.

The rest of Friday went your way. Isaiah Likely practised in full and has no designation, so the tight-end worry is over. Terry McLaurin practised for the first time since 2 Oct and Stefon Diggs is out. Nothing needs doing today. On Sunday at 09:30 read three names on the inactive lists: McLaurin, Jefferson, Addison.

case.label: Their side
case.body: Irving's 31.5 is banked (archive). They changed their lineup at 11:17 this morning: Ja'Marr Chase, 21.8, is on their bench, questionable and still in the concussion protocol after a full practice; Kendre Miller, 7.9, is in their flex. If Chase is cleared on Saturday and they put him back, their 130.8 rises by about fourteen. McBride 18.8, Purdy 18.0, London 16.1.

case.label: Your side
case.body: As set: Allen 20.1, Jefferson 18.6, Wilson 14.8, Warren 14.5, Tuten 14.0, Likely 12.9, Gordon 10.9, Fairbairn 8.5, the Vikings 7.8. None has played. Jefferson is the one questionable starter.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Saturday: O'Connell's decision on Jefferson, Chase's clearance on their side. Sunday 09:30: the inactive lists.

doFirst.deadlineLabel: Fallback only · fire it at the inactive list, Sun 09:30 Mexico City · both kick off Sun 11:00
doFirst.title: Sunday 09:30: McLaurin into the flex if he is active
doFirst.subtitle: He practised on Friday, limited, for the first time since 2 Oct, and is questionable. 12.8 against Gordon's 10.9: a coin flip, and coin flips go to the projection. Wait for the inactive list.

case.label: What the check says
case.body: As set you project 122.1; the projection lineup is 124.0. The whole 1.9 is McLaurin over Gordon in the flex, and the tool now labels it COIN FLIP, not PROJECTION: ESPN cut McLaurin from 13.2 to 12.8 today. The rule for a coin flip is to take the projection and write nothing more.

case.label: What changed today
case.body: This morning's condition was a practice, and he had one: limited, after sitting out Wednesday and Thursday (the joint report on giants.com, 16:00). Dan Quinn: 'Terry, I thought, looked really good today' (PFT). Stefon Diggs is ruled out, so Washington's targets narrow to McLaurin, Antonio Williams and Treylon Burks, and Jayden Daniels starts.

case.label: Why it waits for Sunday
case.body: One limited practice in eight days on a hamstring, and Quinn says the decision comes close to kickoff. McLaurin and Gordon both play at 11:00, so nothing is lost by making the swap at 09:30, and a swap made today is one you must remember to undo.

case.label: If he is inactive
case.body: Gordon, 10.9, keeps the slot. The tool's own fallback is Kamara, 11.2, a 0.3 coin flip with Gordon, and Kamara is himself questionable with a back.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: McLaurin starts in your flex and Gordon outscores him on Sunday (archive). No thesis rides on it either way: it is a coin flip.

doFirst.deadlineLabel: Fallback only · O'Connell decides Saturday · inactives Sun 09:30 Mexico City · kickoff 11:00
doFirst.title: If Jefferson is inactive: Addison, then McLaurin
doFirst.subtitle: Both Vikings receivers are questionable and their coach decides on Saturday. Do nothing now; the order is set here so Sunday is a checklist.

case.label: Where it stands
case.body: Jefferson was limited all three days and is questionable (vikings.com, 13:00). Kevin O'Connell: 'with Justin and Jordan, obviously we'll have to make that determination tomorrow' (PFT, 14:20 ET). No Friday report says he is expected to play, and beat writer Will Ragatz thinks Minnesota could rest him into next week's bye. That last part is an opinion.

case.label: The order
case.body: Addison, 11.4, is the tool's fallback and plays in the same game, but he is questionable too (hamstring, limited Thursday and Friday). If both are inactive, McLaurin, 12.8, takes the receiver slot if he is active and Gordon stays in the flex. All of them kick off at 11:00, so one look at 09:30 settles it.

case.label: If all three sit
case.body: Then you have no healthy receiver for the slot and the free add is Romeo Doubs, 12.2, for Monangai, who is out and in a walking boot. New England play at 11:00 too. It takes three inactives to get there; it is written down so you are not working it out at 09:35.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Jefferson is active and Addison outscores him on Sunday (archive). If Jefferson is inactive this card fires and the open lineup thesis closes untested.

whatWentWrong.title: Monangai is out, in a boot, with no return date
whatWentWrong.lead: The 'rest day' became turf toe on Thursday and a specialist's appointment on Friday.

case.label: The evidence
case.body: Ruled out on Friday without a practice all week (packers.com). Ben Johnson: 'it turns out the toe is a bigger deal than we initially anticipated'; he is in a boot, seeing a specialist and 'week-to-week' (chicagobears.com). D'Andre Swift was full and has no designation.

case.label: What it changes
case.body: No lineup move: he was on your bench and ESPN projects 0.0. It makes his the seat that opens first, which is why the second card's last resort names him as the drop.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: A return to practice next week keeps him. A move to injured reserve or a second missed game makes him the drop for Tuesday's claims, when you also need a defence for Minnesota's bye.

whatWentWrong.title: Both Vikings receivers are questionable, and the bye is next week
whatWentWrong.lead: Jefferson and Addison were limited again and O'Connell would not commit. Your fallback for one is the other.

case.label: The evidence
case.body: Jefferson limited three days, Addison two; both questionable (vikings.com). O'Connell decides on Saturday and says he has prepared 'the whole receivers room' (PFT). Their left tackle is out and their right tackle is questionable.

case.label: What it changes
case.body: The second card's order: Addison first, McLaurin second. It is also why McLaurin's own status matters twice.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: A Saturday report that either will play, or a downgrade to out. Either way the swap is made from the inactive list at 09:30 on Sunday.

whatWentWrong.sources: vikings.com · PFT · Bring Me The Sports via Yahoo

worthALook.name: Romeo Doubs
worthALook.lead: Free, and New England's lead receiver again with Hollins ruled out. The seat he would take is Monangai's.

case.label: The role
case.body: Mack Hollins (calf) did not practise all week and is out (patriots.com, 9 Oct 14:37). In the game Hollins left, Doubs drew 9 targets and scored twice, 23.8 (archive); targets 3, 4, 4, 9. Las Vegas are without receiver Jalen Nailor and New England are without four corners, which points to a game with passing in it.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: 12.2, behind McLaurin's 12.8 and only 1.3 above Gordon, so he does not clearly start this week. A.J. Brown is eligible to come off injured reserve for Week 6, and nobody at New England has said whether he will. A role that may last one more game is not worth an 80%-rostered back.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Monangai going on injured reserve or missing a second week, which opens the seat; or Jefferson, Addison and McLaurin all inactive on Sunday, which makes him a starter that morning. He is a free agent, so waiting costs no priority, only the risk a rival adds him.

worthALook.sources: patriots.com · CBS Boston · Week 1–4 archive · waiver_analysis.py · wire_screen.py

worthALook.name: Rico Dowdle
worthALook.lead: The back who takes carries from your Warren when he returns. Questionable after three limited practices.

case.label: The role
case.body: Limited Wednesday, Thursday and Friday with the toe and questionable (steelers.com, 9 Oct 15:00). With him active Warren took 56% and 55% of the carries; without him, all of them (archive). RotoWire, citing Mike DeFabo, doubts he returns straight to an even split.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: A handcuff to a back you start, on a roster with five backs. He ran 15 times for 37 yards before the injury (archive).

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Nothing makes him an add here. His name on Sunday's inactive list matters for Warren's number, not for your roster.

worthALook.sources: steelers.com · Steelers Depot · RotoWire · Week 1–4 archive

doNotChase.name: Roman Wilson
doNotChase.lead: The wire's biggest riser: Pittman is officially out. His targets did not move the last time that happened.

case.label: The rise
case.body: Michael Pittman Jr. (foot) is out and Mike McCarthy is 'still going through the evaluation of his roster position' (steelers.com, 9 Oct). FantasyPros' Friday column names Wilson as the replacement; Steelers Depot expects Wilson, Germie Bernard and Ben Skowronek to share the snaps.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: Six targets in every one of his four games, the Week 2 game without Pittman included (archive). 10.3, below McLaurin and Addison on your bench.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Eight or more targets against Indianapolis. He is a free agent, so it costs nothing to look again on Tuesday.

doNotChase.sources: steelers.com · Steelers Depot · FantasyPros · Week 1–4 archive

doNotChase.name: Jacoby Brissett
doNotChase.lead: Rising on a matchup that got better today, and you start Josh Allen.

case.label: The rise
case.body: Detroit have allowed the most points to quarterbacks through Week 4 (FootballDB) and on Friday ruled out safety Brian Branch and corner Rock Ya-Sin. The game has the week's highest total, 54.5 (FantasyPros, 9 Oct). Brissett is not on Arizona's report.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: 19.0 against Allen's 20.1, in a league that starts one quarterback.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Allen appearing on Buffalo's final report on Saturday. Nothing else.

doNotChase.sources: FootballDB · FantasyPros · NFL.com's Friday roundup · ESPN league file

doNotChase.name: Jets D/ST
doNotChase.lead: The best free defence now the Jaguars and Bengals are gone, 0.3 above yours.

case.label: The rise
case.body: Cleveland rule out guard Teven Jenkins, receiver Tylan Wallace and tight end Carsen Ryan (clevelandbrowns.com, 9 Oct). Draft Sharks rank the Jets 7th for the week, NBC Sports 8th.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: 8.1 against the Vikings' 7.8, and the same Draft Sharks list has Minnesota first. Under a point is not a streaming move.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Nothing this week. On Tuesday you need a defence for Minnesota's bye, and that is when this row is read again.

doNotChase.sources: ESPN league file · clevelandbrowns.com · Draft Sharks · NBC Sports

doNotChase.name: Will Shipley
doNotChase.lead: Barkley is ruled out. The Inquirer expects Shipley and Pierce to share, and Philadelphia signed a third back today.

case.label: The rise
case.body: Saquon Barkley is out for London and not on injured reserve; Tank Bigsby is on it (philadelphiaeagles.com; Inquirer, 9 Oct 16:38).

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: 'Shipley and Pierce expected to share the running back load' is the Inquirer's wording, no coach has named a starter, and Carson Steele was signed to the 53 on Friday. 15 carries all season (archive). 10.2 is below Warren, Tuten, Kamara and Gordon, behind a line that lost Lane Johnson to retirement and Cam Jurgens to a trade this week.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Fifteen or more touches in London with Barkley still out for Week 6.

doNotChase.name: Malik Washington
doNotChase.lead: A flex recommendation in one Friday column, on a team that is off next week.

case.label: The rise
case.body: Caleb Douglas (ankle) and tight end Justin Joly are out for Miami (bengals.com's copy, 9 Oct); FantasyPros' Friday column calls Washington a flex while Douglas is missing. 5 catches on 5 targets for 67 last week (archive).

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: Targets 8, 5, 10, 5 (archive) in an offence that ran 37 plays last week. Miami are off in Week 6, the week your Vikings are.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Eight or more targets against Cincinnati, or a different quarterback in Miami.

waiverAnalysis.summary: The same four receivers clear the tool's bar, and the bar is still partly an artefact: it measures them against Coker, whose last two weeks are an injury and a missed game. Four weeks of data. Friday changed one of them: Hollins is out, so Doubs's role lasts at least one more game. Nothing clears at running back or tight end.

rising.name: Romeo Doubs
rising.roleReason: Mack Hollins (calf) is ruled out after no practice all week (patriots.com, 9 Oct), so Doubs is New England's lead receiver against Las Vegas. A.J. Brown is eligible to return for Week 6 and his activation is undecided (CBS Boston, 7 Oct).
rising.action: WATCH — a real role for one more game at least; the seat would be Monangai's and that is not yet a drop

rising.name: Dohnte Meyers
rising.roleReason: His 9 targets came after Ja'Marr Chase and Tee Higgins left in Week 4. Both practised in full on Friday and are questionable; Chase can clear the concussion protocol on Saturday (bengals.com; PFT, 9 Oct). Cincinnati are off in Week 6.
rising.action: WATCH — the role shrinks the moment either starter is active, and both are trending that way
rising.sources: bengals.com · PFT · A to Z Sports · Week 4 archive

rising.name: Khalil Shakir
rising.roleReason: 8 targets in the game DJ Moore left with an aggravated AC joint. Moore was not on the field at the start of Friday's practice, a second missed day (CBS/RotoWire citing Joe Buscaglia, 9 Oct); Buffalo's final report comes on Saturday for a Monday game.
rising.action: WATCH — depends on Moore sitting on Monday night; read Saturday's report

rising.name: KC Concepcion
rising.roleReason: The steadiest of the four: targets 5, 6, 9, 8 (archive). Not on Cleveland's final report; receiver Tylan Wallace and tight end Carsen Ryan are out, which removes two other targets (clevelandbrowns.com, 9 Oct).
rising.action: WATCH — real volume at 7.6 points a game, and no receiver seat is open

settled.title: 'McLaurin only if he practises today; otherwise leave Gordon' (Friday morning's first card)
settled.result: He practised, limited, and his coach said he 'looked really good'. The condition is met; ESPN's cut to 12.8 turned the swap into a coin flip, to be made at Sunday's inactive list. Untested until then.

settled.title: 'If Likely is ruled out: add Juwan Johnson' (carried since Wednesday, never fired)
settled.result: Likely practised in full on Friday and has no designation. The card is retired. Waiting cost nothing: Johnson was still free this afternoon.

settled.title: 'No danger to Sunday' for Likely (Thursday afternoon, from a team-site writer)
settled.result: This morning it could not be found again and was marked down. It held: full practice, no game status.

settled.title: 'Monangai is not the drop until the thumb is known' (4–5 Oct)
settled.result: The thumb was never the problem. He is out with a toe, in a boot, seeing a specialist. The hold is leaning WRONG and closes that way if he misses Week 6 as well.

settled.title: 'If McLaurin has not practised, the flex goes to Kamara, then Gordon' (Wednesday afternoon)
settled.result: You moved Gordon in for Kamara at 16:41 on Wednesday, after Kamara's back listing. Graded on Sunday.

settled.title: 'Jefferson back in for Addison' (Tuesday's and Wednesday morning's first card)
settled.result: You made the swap at 13:08 on Wednesday, and he practised, limited, three hours later. Graded on Sunday.

settled.title: 'Metcalf on Thursday; one more day is a small risk' (Wednesday morning's brief)
settled.result: Nicky Jam added him at 07:00, eleven minutes after the snapshot. Boston went at 06:49. Closed WRONG: the wait lost both.

settled.title: Kamara in the flex once McLaurin and Coker were out (the contingency, 2–4 Oct)
settled.result: Archive: Kamara 22.8, but Monangai, still unlocked when the swap was made, scored 28.0. Closed WRONG by 5.2, as its own falsifier said.

settled.title: 'Start Kamara in the flex; bench Coker' (Sunday morning's brief)
settled.result: Coker was inactive and scored 0; Kamara scored 22.8 (archive). Closed RIGHT.

settled.title: If Jefferson is inactive, add Addison and start him (30 Sep)
settled.result: It fired. Archive: Addison 9.1, Kamara 22.8. The falsifier named Kamara, so it closes WRONG. Boston, the player you dropped for him, scored 12.9.

settled.title: Dropping Kyle Pitts on usage (22 Sep)
settled.result: Archive: Likely beat him 3.3 to 1.5 and 13.6 to 7.7, so the two-of-three clause can't fire. His snap share was 59% in Week 3 and I could not get a figure for Monday; PFF says 'typical 2026 levels'. Closed RIGHT on the scores.

settled.title: Tuten in the RB slot over the bench backs (the projection lineup)
settled.result: Archive: Tuten 11.1, Monangai 28.0, Gordon 18.0. No brief overrode the projection; the projection lost.

settled.title: 'Fairbairn is 0.5 better; under a point isn't a move' (Sunday morning's brief)
settled.result: You made the swap. Archive: Fairbairn 16, Pineiro 5. The hold closed WRONG by 11.

settled.title: Claim Gordon for Achane: 'under 12 touches in Week 4 means a timeshare' (28 Sep)
settled.result: He had 11 touches, so it closed WRONG as written, and scored 18.0. The clause was badly written; the claim gained.
